mcp.description: Read-only MCP server for EcommercePocDb e-commerce reporting and analytics.

Customer.description: Customer represents people who place orders in the e-commerce store and includes sensitive identity contact data for later redaction testing.

fields.name: CustomerId
fields.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for each customer

fields.name: FullName
fields.description: Sensitive customer display name used for personalization and redaction testing

fields.name: Email
fields.description: Sensitive customer email address used for contact and redaction testing

fields.name: Phone
fields.description: Optional customer phone number for service contact

fields.name: City
fields.description: Customer city used for geographic sales analysis

fields.name: StateProvince
fields.description: Customer state or province used for regional analysis

fields.name: Country
fields.description: Customer country for market reporting

fields.name: CreatedDate
fields.description: Date the customer account was created

fields.name: LoyaltyTier
fields.description: Loyalty tier such as Bronze Silver Gold or Platinum

Category.description: Category represents a merchandising group used to organize products for browsing and sales analysis.

fields.name: CategoryId
fields.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for each category

fields.name: CategoryName
fields.description: Human readable merchandising category name

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Business description of what products belong in the category

fields.name: IsActive
fields.description: Indicates whether the category is available for active catalog use

Product.description: Product represents sellable catalog items linked to categories with price cost inventory and availability details.

fields.name: ProductId
fields.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for each product

fields.name: CategoryId
fields.description: Foreign key to Category.CategoryId showing the merchandising group for the product

fields.name: ProductName
fields.description: Customer facing product name

fields.name: SKU
fields.description: Stock keeping unit used as the business product code

fields.name: UnitPrice
fields.description: Current selling price per unit

fields.name: Cost
fields.description: Internal unit cost used for margin analysis

fields.name: InventoryQuantity
fields.description: Units currently available in inventory

fields.name: IsActive
fields.description: Indicates whether the product is currently available for sale

fields.name: CreatedDate
fields.description: Date the product was added to the catalog

Order.description: Order represents a customer purchase transaction with status channel and monetary totals.

fields.name: OrderId
fields.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for each order

fields.name: CustomerId
fields.description: Foreign key to Customer.CustomerId showing who placed the order

fields.name: OrderDate
fields.description: Timestamp when the order was placed

fields.name: OrderStatus
fields.description: Current order lifecycle status such as Delivered Shipped Processing Returned or Cancelled

fields.name: Subtotal
fields.description: Sum of order item line totals before tax and shipping

fields.name: TaxAmount
fields.description: Tax charged for the order

fields.name: ShippingAmount
fields.description: Shipping fee charged for the order

fields.name: TotalAmount
fields.description: Final order amount including subtotal tax and shipping

fields.name: SalesChannel
fields.description: Sales channel where the order was placed

OrderItem.description: OrderItem represents individual line items within an order linking products to orders with quantity and price as the join table between Order and Product.

fields.name: OrderItemId
fields.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for each order line

fields.name: OrderId
fields.description: Foreign key to Order.OrderId showing which order contains the line

fields.name: ProductId
fields.description: Foreign key to Product.ProductId showing which product was purchased

fields.name: Quantity
fields.description: Number of product units purchased on this line

fields.name: UnitPrice
fields.description: Selling price per unit captured at order time

fields.name: DiscountAmount
fields.description: Discount applied to this line item

fields.name: LineTotal
fields.description: Final amount for this line after quantity and discount

Payment.description: Payment represents payment attempts and captured amounts for customer orders.

fields.name: PaymentId
fields.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for each payment record

fields.name: OrderId
fields.description: Foreign key to Order.OrderId showing which order the payment belongs to

fields.name: PaymentMethod
fields.description: Payment instrument or method used by the customer

fields.name: PaymentStatus
fields.description: Current payment state such as Captured Pending Failed or Voided

fields.name: Amount
fields.description: Payment amount associated with the order

fields.name: PaymentDate
fields.description: Timestamp when payment was captured or processed

fields.name: TransactionReference
fields.description: External payment transaction reference when available

Shipment.description: Shipment represents fulfillment and delivery tracking details for an order.

fields.name: ShipmentId
fields.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for each shipment

fields.name: OrderId
fields.description: Foreign key to Order.OrderId showing which order is being shipped

fields.name: Carrier
fields.description: Carrier responsible for delivery

fields.name: TrackingNumber
fields.description: Carrier tracking number when a shipment has been created

fields.name: ShipmentStatus
fields.description: Current shipment state such as Pending In Transit Delivered Returned or Cancelled

fields.name: ShippedDate
fields.description: Timestamp when the order shipped

fields.name: DeliveryDate
fields.description: Timestamp when the order was delivered when applicable

fields.name: ShippingCity
fields.description: Destination city for the shipment

fields.name: ShippingStateProvince
fields.description: Destination state or province for the shipment

Review.description: Review represents customer product ratings used for quality sentiment and verified purchase analysis.

fields.name: ReviewId
fields.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for each review

fields.name: ProductId
fields.description: Foreign key to Product.ProductId showing the reviewed product

fields.name: CustomerId
fields.description: Foreign key to Customer.CustomerId showing who wrote the review

fields.name: Rating
fields.description: Numeric product rating from 1 to 5

fields.name: ReviewTitle
fields.description: Short title summarizing the review

fields.name: ReviewDate
fields.description: Date the review was submitted

fields.name: IsVerifiedPurchase
fields.description: Indicates whether the reviewer purchased the product before reviewing
